answer: For Scope 1 and 2 under operational control, Shell targets a 50% net reduction by 2030 from 83 MtCO2e in 2016; carbon credits may be used for remaining operational emissions. For products sold, it targets a 15–20% net-carbon-intensity reduction by 2030 from 78 gCO2e/MJ in 2016, on an equity boundary, sales-volume weighted, well-to-wheel and net of carbon credits. Methane intensity is to remain below 0.2% and reach near zero by 2030; it is calculated separately for marketed-gas and non-marketed-gas assets. Routine flaring from upstream operations was targeted for elimination and was achieved in January 2025, independently of the later SPDC sale.
